description: Harvest Keynote and PDF slide decks into previews, text, image assets, and a manifest for agents.
name: io.github.hulin42/keynote-harvest-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Path-delimited directories the server may read decks from (e.g. your Keynote documents and Downloads). Required to harvest local files.
environmentVariables.name: KEYNOTE_HARVEST_ALLOWED_INPUT_ROOTS

environmentVariables.description: Directory where harvests are written. Defaults to .harvests under the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: KEYNOTE_HARVEST_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: Directory relative paths resolve from. Defaults to the host's current directory.
environmentVariables.name: KEYNOTE_HARVEST_WORKING_DIRECTORY
